messages:
Raj: quick post-all-hands sync on runtime perf/batching/kernel questions. dropping short Qs + answers so folks can act.

Elaine: first: whats our default canary tempo for kernel changes now? small steps or faster?

Raj: conservative by default: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 24h holds. ops can request faster cadence for low-risk changes.

Sam: what exact metrics will cause an immediate abort vs a warning? need clear thresholds for playbooks.

Raj: immediate aborts = p99 > 2x baseline OR OOM spikes OR token error-rate > 3x. warnings = p95 > 1.25x, kv hit-rate drop > 15%, batch-reject > 5%.

Julie: for batching/autotune, will we expose per-route overrides in the Console or only API?

Elaine: both. Console UI gets a simple toggle + sliders for max_batch_delay and max_batch_size; full config is available via API.

Morgan: adaptive-cache question: default TTL change or opt-in? customers worry about cache correctness.

Elaine: opt-in per-route for now. default stays 30s. plan: GA adaptive-cache after 4 weeks of stable signals. docs will show how to opt-out.

Sam: can someone paste the canary YAML we agreed so SRE can wire alerts?

Elaine: paste here:

```
canary:
  phases:
    - pct: 2
      hold: 24h
    - pct: 10
      hold: 24h
    - pct: 50
      hold: 48h
signals:
  latency:
    p95_multiplier: 1.15
  errors:
    multiplier: 2.0
  kv:
    hit_rate_drop: 0.15
  mem:
    oom_spike_rate: 0.01
```

Sam: perfect, I'll add dashboards + an automated rollback runbook that triggers on abort conditions.

Raj: telemetry owners: make sure per-route batch-size p50/p90/p99, batch-wait hist, kv hit-rate, and kernel-selection events are in the default SLO dashboard.

CanaryBot: rollout-controller: experiment/attention-kernel-v3 started at 1833333555 :rocket:

Julie: thanks all  I'll draft the 3-bullet release note (non-technical) and link to deep-dive. Elaine, can you own the deep doc?

Elaine: yes  first draft by next Tue.

Raj: great. if anyone sees odd spikes after the rollout starts, paste screenshots here and ping oncall.
